title: Height Difference Filter Feature
description: Filters away positions based on the heightmap around the placement position.The filter will check for surface blocks in each cardinal direction within the `search_radius`. Each block will be checked against all given conditions.

places_feature.title: Places Feature
places_feature.description: Named reference of feature to be placed

min_required_upward_height_diff.title: Minimum Required Upward Height Difference
min_required_upward_height_diff.description: Specifies the minimum height difference required upwards.

min_required_downward_height_diff.title: Minimum Required Downward Height Difference
min_required_downward_height_diff.description: Specifies the minimum height difference required downwards.

max_allowed_upward_height_diff.title: Maximum Allowed Upward Height Difference
max_allowed_upward_height_diff.description: Specifies the maximum height difference allowed upwards.

max_allowed_downward_height_diff.title: Maximum Allowed Downward Height Difference
max_allowed_downward_height_diff.description: Specifies the maximum height difference allowed downwards.

search_radius.title: Search Radius
search_radius.description: Specifies the length in each cardinal direction the filter will check for blocks against the given differences.
